# AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas — facts

> Source-anchored units about AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas: 14 across 10 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-31 · 14 units · 10 sources · rights: quote -->

## How it works

- [statement] Commitment drawdown does not automatically apply the customer AWS infrastructure discount to Atlas charges. Procurement and FinOps guidance distinguish the vendor private-offer price from the AWS commitment discount; use the vendor price when modelling eligible Marketplace purchases. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-21) — https://www.isvcosell.com/benchmarks/guides/managed-database-procurement-models · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas · also: https://www.cloudforecast.io/blog/aws-edp-guide/

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] CloudForecast reports a 25% annual-commitment cap for eligible Marketplace purchases and a Deployed on AWS eligibility requirement. This is dated practitioner guidance, not proof of the cap or eligibility for a particular Atlas offer or customer agreement. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-21) — https://www.cloudforecast.io/blog/aws-edp-guide/ · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Marketplace contribution is subject to the limit in the buyer's cloud agreement. DoiT illustrates a 25% limit with $250,000 against a $1 million commitment and notes that some products have cap exemptions; Duckbill describes 100% of eligible purchase dollars counting within a 25% annual cap for the contract terms it discusses. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-21) — https://help.doit.com/docs/optimize/commitment-manager · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas · also: https://www.duckbillhq.com/blog/new-aws-marketplace-rules/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Eligible MongoDB Atlas purchases through AWS Marketplace can retire an existing AWS spending commitment. MongoDB describes this drawdown path; independent procurement guidance makes eligibility conditional on the customer commitment agreement rather than promising every Atlas transaction qualifies. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-06-16) — https://siliconangle.com/2026/06/16/database-market-mongodb-atlas-aws-marketplace-awsmarketplaceseries/ · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas · also: https://www.isvcosell.com/benchmarks/guides/managed-database-procurement-models
- [statement] CloudForecast's August 2026 guide distinguishes commitment retirement from a price discount: eligible Marketplace purchases consume commitment at full value but remain billed at the vendor's price rather than receiving the AWS EDP service discount. Any Atlas-specific negotiated discount therefore needs separate confirmation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-21) — https://www.cloudforecast.io/blog/aws-edp-guide/ · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas offers an AWS Marketplace pay-as-you-go subscription without an upfront Atlas usage commitment. This purchasing option is distinct from having an AWS EDP commitment and does not itself establish EDP eligibility. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas · also: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-mongodb-atlas/best-practices.html
- [statement] Before budgeting Atlas Marketplace drawdown, check the agreement eligibility rules, remaining Marketplace allowance, and commitment term. Marketplace participation alone is insufficient to establish unlimited drawdown. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-21) — https://www.isvcosell.com/benchmarks/guides/managed-database-procurement-models · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas · also: https://www.cloudforecast.io/blog/aws-edp-guide/
- [statement] For the self-serve subscription path, MongoDB instructs buyers to subscribe on AWS Marketplace and link an Atlas organization to the AWS billing account. Outstanding or failed Atlas invoices must be resolved before linking; the procedure explicitly excludes Marketplace Contracts. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas
- [statement] Cancelling the Atlas pay-as-you-go Marketplace subscription unlinks AWS billing but does not delete Atlas resources or data; those resources continue to incur charges. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas
- [statement] A participant in the AWS Marketplace buyer discussion reports using it to pay MongoDB Atlas usage and simplify internal finance approval. This is anonymous practitioner evidence of procurement value, not audited proof of EDP drawdown or a discount. (low confidence) — https://www.reddit.com/r/aws/comments/1bvyt8a/do_people_actually_use_aws_marketplace/ · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas
- [statement] MongoDB Atlas can be purchased through AWS Marketplace using pay-as-you-go billing without an upfront Atlas usage commitment; MongoDB also supports privately negotiated Marketplace offers. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2025-09-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/introducing-pay-as-you-go-mongodb-atlas-aws-marketplace · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md
- [statement] From May 1, 2025, AWS restricts SaaS commitment retirement to eligible products deployed entirely on AWS, identified by the Deployed on AWS badge; mere presence in AWS Marketplace does not establish eligibility. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-21) — https://www.bytes.co.uk/application/files/3017/4549/0883/AWS_Marketplace_SaaS_Policy_Update_-_Customer_FAQ_1_1_1.pdf · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas · also: https://help.doit.com/docs/optimize/commitment-manager, https://www.duckbillhq.com/blog/new-aws-marketplace-rules/
- [statement] The inspected MongoDB Atlas Enterprise Marketplace listing displays Deployed on AWS: Yes. Together with AWS's eligibility policy, this supports treating that specific listing as a candidate for commitment retirement, subject to the buyer's agreement; it does not establish eligibility for every Atlas offer or deployment. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-zfief2k5r54q4 · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas · also: https://www.bytes.co.uk/application/files/3017/4549/0883/AWS_Marketplace_SaaS_Policy_Update_-_Customer_FAQ_1_1_1.pdf
- [statement] AWS's 2025 customer FAQ applies SaaS commitment eligibility by invoice date, including existing multi-year agreements and future-dated private offers: invoices on or after May 1, 2025 require the eligibility tag. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-05-01) — https://www.bytes.co.uk/application/files/3017/4549/0883/AWS_Marketplace_SaaS_Policy_Update_-_Customer_FAQ_1_1_1.pdf · keywords: AWS Marketplace EDP drawdown for Atlas
